source: Sifra, Shemini, Mechilta d'Miluim 2 21-22; 32 + Onkelos Lev 10:1
claim_en: THE STRANGE FIRE. Token-per-fault reads; R. Yishmael's uncounseled-fire vs R. Akiva's stove-fire; the two recorded motive arms.
THE MODE AND THE WHERE. Nostril-threads, soul-not-garments; R. Eliezer's outside vs R. Akiva's inside; the rule-before-the-master law.

source: Sifra, Shemini, Mechilta d'Miluim 2 36 (with 23) + Onkelos Lev 10:3
claim_en: BIKROVAI EKADESH. The Sinai word understood at the event; Aaron's rewarded silence — the accept-and-be-still law.

source: Sifra, Shemini, Mechilta d'Miluim 2 25-27; 37 + Onkelos Lev 10:4
claim_en: THE CARRIERS. Priests do not defile — the Levites carry; Uzziel paired to Aaron; Onkelos's exact kinship decode.
THE MOURNING BANS. Hair-growth pri'ah; the transposed weeping clause; no rites for Heaven's executed; the soul-burning export.

source: Sifra, Shemini, Mechilta d'Miluim 2 42-43 + Onkelos Lev 10:7
claim_en: THE EXIT BAN. In-service only; extended to all generations by the oil clause; Onkelos's oil-of-greatness.
THE WINE MACHINE. Quarter-log of forty-day wine (data); the three recorded arms; in-service scope; drunk service invalid; the statute-statute syncs; Onkelos's functional intoxicant.
THE CURRICULUM VERSE. The canon layers enumerated; the Targum's status asked on the page; the ruling-death exemptions with their provenance split.
THE DAY'S GRAIN AND PORTIONS. The hour's communal minchah; chambers-open-to-holy; sons in the share, daughters in the gifts; the three command-verbs; inheritance-precedence = honor-precedence.
THE GOAT INQUIRY. Three goats, two inquiries; priests-eat-owners-atoned; the mourning-vs-impurity fork with its refutations; the scribal night ban; Moses' recorded I-heard-and-forgot.

source: Mishnah Keritot 3:3; Zevachim 17b:7-18a:6; Keritot 13b:6, 13b:16-20; Sanhedrin 22b:11-14, 83b:17; Sifra, Shemini, Section 1 8-9
claim_en: THE WINE BAN'S TWO JOBS AT THEIR TALMUD SEATS. 'To distinguish' carries the drunk's service profaned (Zevachim 17b:7, the statute-statute sync 18a:1-5; Rav Ashi at Sanhedrin 22b:14); 'to teach' carries the teaching bar with the plain text excepted (Keritot 13b:16-20); the ban today per Rabbi (Sanhedrin 22b:11-12); the quarter-log's dissipation measure (22b:13). Filed F-207, auto-seated (sitting L1).

source: Mishnah Horayot 3:5; Mishnah Zevachim 12:1; Zevachim 101a:2-15, 101b:1-7; Sifra, Shemini, Chapter 1 8, Chapter 2 1-2, 4, 11
claim_en: THE INQUIRY AT ITS TALMUD SEAT — MOSES HIMSELF OFFERED. Zevachim 101a-b carries Sifra Shemini Chapter 2 verbatim (the three goats, the doubled inquiry, mourning vs impurity, 'I heard and forgot'); the sons did not offer — 'did they offer? I offered' (101a:9, 14); the generations' mourner-ban from the tithe's a-fortiori (101a:10-11). Filed F-208, auto-seated (sitting L1).
